{
  "analysis": "Lowercased training, validation, and test data have been created. The old oversized model has been removed. We now need to train a better model on lowercased text and then quantize it to meet both accuracy and size requirements. Based on fasttext paper results for Yelp Full, dim=200 with wordNgrams=2 should achieve around 63-64% accuracy.",
  "plan": "1. Concatenate train and validation files to use all 650k rows for final training.
2. Train with dim=200, bucket=200k, wordNgrams=2, epoch=10, lr=0.7 (fasttext paper hyperparameters for Yelp Full).
3. Quantize the model with cutoff and retrain to reduce size dramatically while preserving accuracy.
4. Save quantized model to /app/model.bin, evaluate on test set, and check size.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "cat /app/work/train_lower.txt /app/work/valid_lower.txt > /app/work/full_train_lower.txt && wc -l /app/work/full_train_lower.txt
",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "python3 - <<'PY'
import fasttext
import os
import time

print('Training full model on lowercased data...')
start = time.time()
model = fasttext.train_supervised(
    input='/app/work/full_train_lower.txt',
    dim=200,
    bucket=200000,
    wordNgrams=2,
    epoch=10,
    lr=0.7,
    minCount=2,
    thread=4,
    verbose=2
)
print(f'Training time: {time.time()-start:.1f}s')

# Evaluate before quantization
result = model.test('/app/work/test_lower.txt')
print(f'Before quantization - Test samples: {result[0]}, accuracy: {result[1]:.4f}')

# Save unquantized model temporarily
model.save_model('/app/work/model_full.bin')
print(f'Full model size: {os.path.getsize("/app/work/model_full.bin")/1024/1024:.2f} MB')

# Quantize the model
print('Quantizing model...')
model.quantize(
    input='/app/work/full_train_lower.txt',
    retrain=True,
    qnorm=True,
    cutoff=50000,
    thread=4,
    verbose=2
)

# Save quantized model
model.save_model('/app/model.bin')
print(f'Quantized model saved to /app/model.bin')
print(f'Quantized model size: {os.path.getsize("/app/model.bin")/1024/1024:.2f} MB')

# Evaluate after quantization
result = model.test('/app/work/test_lower.txt')
print(f'After quantization - Test samples: {result[0]}, accuracy: {result[1]:.4f}')
PY
",
      "duration": 60.0
    }
  ]
}
